Here’s a quick roundup of some of the most highly‑rated crime‑thriller films released in 2020:

| # | Title | Director | Key Cast | Why It Stands Out |
|---|-------|----------|----------|-------------------|
| 1 | **The Invisible Man** (2017) – *2020 re‑release* | Leigh Whannell | Elisabeth Moss, Oliver Jackson-Cohen | A tense, psychological thriller that blends horror with a modern take on domestic abuse. |
| 2 | **The Trial of the Chicago 7** | Aaron Sorkin | Eddie Redmayne, Sacha Baron Cohen | A courtroom drama that mixes political intrigue with sharp dialogue, capturing the spirit of the 1969 trial. |
| 3 | **The Hunt** | Thomas Vinterberg | Mads Mikkelsen, Nikolaj Coster-Waldau | A Danish film that explores paranoia and social media hysteria through a gripping narrative. |
| 4 | **The Last Duel** | Ridley Scott | Matt Damon, Adam Driver, Jodie Comer | A historical crime‑thriller that examines truth, justice, and gender dynamics in medieval France. |
| 5 | **The Irishman** | Martin Scorsese | Robert De Niro, Al Pacino, Joe Pesci | A long‑form crime epic that uses time‑jump storytelling to explore organized crime and aging. |

These films were widely praised for their direction, performances, and ability to keep audiences on edge. If you’re looking for a mix of suspense, strong character work, and thought‑provoking themes, any of these would be a solid pick.
